title: Putin says he won’t deal with Ukrainian ‘terrorists’ but praises U.S. mediators
summary_full: The Russian president’s remarks at a 3 a.m. news conference — and Moscow’s intensifying strikes on Kyiv — suggested that he sees little chance of a deal to end his war in Ukraine.
